title: docsrs-cli dry-run success envelope fragment
description: When global --dry-run is set on a network command, success envelopes include dry_run=true and data with planned_url plus planned_params. planned_params always use crate_name (never crate). For get-item method dry-run, planned_params may also include validation=url_shape_only, planned_parent_kind, and parent_kind_probe (method-specific; not required).

planned_params.description: Command-specific planned fields; crate fields use crate_name. search-in-crate planned limit is clamped to 1000 even if --limit is higher. Keys vary by command, so additionalProperties remains true only on this bag. For get-item method dry-run, optional keys include validation (url_shape_only), planned_parent_kind, and parent_kind_probe (array of kind strings); these are method-specific and not required.

validation.description: Present on get-item method dry-run: plan validates URL shape only (does not verify remote existence).

planned_parent_kind.description: Present on get-item method dry-run: default parent kind used to build planned_url (live fetch may probe other kinds).

parent_kind_probe.description: Present on get-item method dry-run: ordered parent kind strings live fetch may probe on 404.
